calculation.description: Cross-asset dispersion is the mean absolute deviation of each asset's daily return from the universe median return. Apply a graded positive activation to the three-session reversal signal when current dispersion exceeds its 60-session median; cross-sectional ranks are used for portfolio scoring. All inputs are lag-safe and use completed daily data.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR across reported 2020, 2023, 2025 and 2026-07 regime slices; predictive strength decays materially by 10 sessions. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
